description:
A project that uses the plugin the way a consumer would, and the only place the
        plugin actually runs.

        Everything else is tested by calling the generator directly, which never proves the
        Mojo can be configured, that the language target is found through ServiceLoader out
        of a plugin classloader, that the output directory is registered as a test source
        root, or that generated code compiles against models a real openapi-generator
        emitted rather than ones written by hand to look like it.

        It replaces an integration-test module that contained nothing but a pom. Being an
        example rather than a test suite is the point: it has to stay readable, which is a
        harder constraint than passing, and it is what a newcomer will copy.
